{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()}')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check for assay_batch unit issue
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check for sample_seq duplicates per patient_id
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
df_with_max_seq = df.merge(sample_seq_max.reset_index(), on='patient_id', suffixes=('', '_max'))
print(f'Rows with sample_seq < max sample_seq per patient: {(df_with_max_seq["sample_seq"] < df_with_max_seq["sample_seq_max"]).sum()}')

# Confirm arm values
df["arm"].value_counts()"}
